name: JavOrganizer
overview: JAV metadata and cover art from 18 websites, scraped in parallel
description: Identifies JAV titles by product code in the file name and scrapes up to 18 websites simultaneously per code — JavLibrary, JavDB, JavBus, MissAV (+mirror), OneJAV, FANZA/DMM digital + DVD, JavLand, 123AV, SEXTB, SupJav, JavGG, JavSeen, JavMix, JavQuick, JavTube and MGStage — merging English titles, actresses and male actors, studio, genres, release date, runtime, cover art and scene backdrops. Advanced anti-ban system: per-site rate limiting with randomized jitter, rotating coherent browser fingerprints, exponential backoff, automatic ban detection with cooldown, unreachable circuit breaker and Cloudflare bypass via optional FlareSolverr. Automatic scanning (startup + 6-hourly scheduled task + title-only self-healing), manual Scan and Deep Re-scrape buttons with live progress, and gender-aware people collections.

versions.changelog: Live-tested end to end on Jellyfin 12.0 with a 1204-video library. 18-site scraping with per-code site cap and priority ranking; English-first merging (Latin titles/cast/studios preferred over Japanese-only variants); error and interstitial pages (403 ERROR, Redirecting, challenge pages) never parse into records; fixed Cloudflare detection so solved pages from English sources are actually used; per-host Referer image downloads (javbus covers fixed); advanced anti-ban/anti-detect (rotating browser profiles, jittered pacing, exponential backoff, 6-hour ban cooldown, unreachable circuit breaker); automatic scraping fixed for files added while the server runs (6-hourly scheduled task, thin-record self-healing, title-only retry); manual Scan + Deep Re-scrape buttons with live progress and cancel; JavBus rewritten against the real 2026 markup; stable code-based provider ids; cancel-safe deep scan; 82-check test suite.
